why_now: writing the evaluator after seeing forward X is not outcome leakage but is a real discretionary channel: boundary inclusivity, missing-value handling, timestamp alignment, session-validity edge cases and tie semantics would all be settled while looking at the data the rules must be applied to

m15.method: raw rule evaluation, restricted to the sealed population and to overlap blocks recomputed from the sealed block labels, compared to the sealed membership from the engine bundle

h1.method: necessary condition only: every sealed member must be reproduced. The 1H block assignment was never persisted separately, so the overlap restriction cannot be re-applied and the extra episodes are REPORTED, not asserted to be zero.

historical_replay.asymmetry_is_stated: the two families are not replayed with equal strength

reference_vs_candidate.reference: eval_15m / eval_1h — canonical scalar, RETAINED as the frozen oracle
reference_vs_candidate.equality: exact bitwise at (episode x claim) grain; no tolerance, membership is boolean
reference_vs_candidate.not_re_derived_here: restating this gate more weakly inside the freeze would be the very hole it exists to close

session_length_table.why: derived from the frame, the modal session length makes 1H membership SESSION-local rather than episode-local: evaluate a subset of episodes and the mode could move. Supplied as a frozen input it is episode-local by construction, which is what makes chunked ingestion safe. The derivation is empirically robust — a 40-ticker subset reproduced it on 959/959 shared sessions — but robustness is not invariance, and the forward path is chunked.
session_length_table.tie_rule: ties resolve to the smallest modal value; fixed so it cannot be re-decided
session_length_table.unknown_session: raises UnknownSession rather than silently excluding the whole day

claims_15m.episode_chunk_1_why_sampled: chunk=1 over the full frame is 114,295 evaluator calls; a 200-episode sample is reported rather than silently skipped

invariance.why: ingestion batch size is an operational parameter and must never become a scientific one

implementations.reference_never_deleted: eval_15m / eval_1h stay in the module unchanged, so any future optimisation is checked against an oracle that has not moved
implementations.licence: extensional equivalence on every admissible input
